rows.missing: An accepted non-Dawnport main-world trial rule and trigger, including entitlement/removal of temporary items, outfit and learned spells below level 20. The donors gate trial changes on Dawnport trial tiles; there is no donor-defined main-world trial grant to transplant.
rows.investigation: Fetched both donor trial scripts, checked existing vocation conversion and starting-loadout owners. The level-20 limit is a Dawnport tile guard, not a global main-world grant. User explicitly excludes Dawnport, assigns starting kits to Newhaven and S17 casting elsewhere, and excludes SRV7 outfit acquisition. Asked for the accepted main-world trial specification; none was supplied. No Dawnport, starting-kit, outfit-acquisition or casting changes.

rows.rules: Completion is once per species after qualifying Soulpit survival. Mastered species receive 2% raw XP plus 0.1% per ten completed species, capped at 4% total. Ordinary kills consume this bonus; they do not create a separate mastery kill counter. Soul Core use selects/consumes the core through the existing activity owner; item use must not grant mastery before successful completion.
rows.requested_loot_clarification: Neither pinned donor Animus owner defines a loot bonus or ordinary-kill mastery accumulation. Follow the existing accepted ANIMUS-1 contract and donor behavior; do not invent a loot multiplier or grant mastery merely for using a core. If a separate loot/progress mechanic is intended, its accepted formula and acquisition rule are missing and that extension is BLOCKED. The Soul Core/Prism loot callbacks in both donors depend on fiendish classification and configured drop chances, not on Animus Mastery.
rows.already_done_scope: The requested non-BOSS2 donor-defined owner: per-species mastery persistence, mastered-species kill XP bonus, existing Soul Core item-use admission and the clearly existing Soulpit completion hook. Full activity entry/return availability remains BOSS2 W07 and is not claimed complete.
rows.missing: The legitimate BOSS2 destination Instance admission/activity adapter needed to execute the Soulpit completion-to-mastery path. The base supplies SHARED_OWNER_ADMISSION = None, and its completion atomicity cases are explicitly ignored as NOT_RUN. SRV10 must consume the existing hook, not implement BOSS2 entry/return. The requested additional loot bonus/ordinary-kill accumulation also has no rule in either pinned donor; an accepted formula/acquisition rule is needed if this is intended beyond current Tibia Animus behavior.
rows.investigation: Inspected the fenced mastery store, existing kill reward XP consumer, Soul Core item-use admission and completion transaction. A repository search for ActivityHandoffOwnerRuntime implementations finds only soulpit/runtime/tests.rs:117. The focused Animus persistence and real query-dispatch PG tests execute successfully; the completion atomicity test is NOT_RUN because the legitimate BOSS2 admission adapter is absent. Implementing activity entry/return here would duplicate the explicitly excluded BOSS2 W07 owner.
